added.statement: The dotfiles Home Manager profile shall own one Droid Remote Control systemd user service that runs the managed Droid wrapper, starts only for a locally registered computer, restarts after failure, and is enabled at the user default target.
acceptance_criteria: home/home.nix imports the Droid Remote Control module
The service is enabled at default.target and restarts on failure
droid computer list identifies cc-se-sto-devbox-01 as this machine
The Codex managed daemon declaration remains unchanged

ears.trigger: the operator applies the cc-se-sto-devbox-01 profile
ears.response: install and enable one droid-remote-control user service that runs the registered Droid computer through the Factory relay

breaker.condition: the profile has no managed Droid Remote Control service, the service does not use the managed wrapper, or live readback shows it inactive

test_plan.description: The focused dotfiles contract test fails before the module exists and proves the declared import, managed command, conditions, enablement, restart policy, and unchanged Codex ownership after implementation.
After applying the profile, systemctl user readback proves the service is active and droid computer list proves the current registered computer is present.
